key_findings: 6 of 8 hooks lack shock words (banned, hidden, secret, etc.)
L00100 hook is 20 words — exceeds 12-word maximum
Best hook: S01185 'A company called Clearview AI scraped 40 billion photos' (8/10)
Worst hooks: S01110, S01117, S01279 — flat statements without urgency
recommendations: Inject 1-2 shock words (banned, secret, hidden, only, never, billion) in opening sentence
Cap hook at 8 words for shorts, 12 for longs
Lead with a number when possible — 7/10 vs 4/10 average
